- Other weights are proportionally renormalized
- I need to explicitly identify the shock and return the t1 decision object

However, the user hasn't provided the full t0 decision object with all criteria, weights, hard constraints, etc. They only mention the energy weight change. Criteria: at least 4 items. Each with name, direction (cost or benefit), weight.
